_broker_note: Broker-only mode: every LLM process requires a live llm-quota-broker lease. Local counters are telemetry only; there is no local inference fallback. Interactive work waits in the protocol queue, while daemon and cron work defer to the next scheduled cycle.

broker._protocol_tokens_note: V4.110.0: keyed by protocol name, because these differ by an order of magnitude and one shared prior can only be right for one end of that range. Each key is reported to the broker as task type `agentic_protocol-<name>`, so `lqb history --stats --task-type agentic_protocol-triage` shows that protocol's own p50 rather than an average of unlike things. `default` covers any protocol without a row. MEASURED means real settled tokens are behind the number; the rest are still the deliberately-generous V4.106.0 prior. (V4.111.4 changed the separator from `:` to `-`: the colon is outside the broker's task_type pattern, so every protocol run was 400'd and blocked. Nothing was recorded under the colon form — there is no history to migrate.)
